name: dailymeteo
description: Historical weather and climate normals for any land location: 1 km grids, 1961 to today. Daily, monthly and annual values, climate normals, links to the DailyMeteo app and the MeteoEurope1km archives.

dailymeteo_api_key.title: DailyMeteo API key (optional)
dailymeteo_api_key.description: From https://app.dailymeteo.com/ (Account), for daily values, which use the account's credits. Leave empty to use only the free data.
